observed_steps: Started the checked-in filesystem MCP server as a real stdio child process with an isolated temporary root.
Paired a temporary device and established the Local Runtime websocket connection to a loopback test service.
Observed the local.mcp.fs.read_file capability advertised through the broker.
Dispatched a task through the device endpoint and completed local consent.
Verified the task completed with a broker receipt and the MCP file content.
scope_note: This proves the stdio MCP process and broker receipt path in the device integration harness. It does not prove a production Gateway Agent Run to Run Evidence chain; no real device is registered in the active Gateway database.
